naming_conventions.inconsistency_note: W10 and W12 peer review schemas use different placeholder styles for the same semantic roles (reviewer, reviewed party). W10 says '<your_lastname>_reviews_<partner_lastname>' while W12 says '<reviewer>_reviews_<author>'. These should be harmonized.
naming_conventions.convention_note: ALL_CAPS = project-root special/persistent files (one per project); snake_case_<lastname>.ext = per-student deliverables. ALL_CAPS files intentionally have no <lastname> suffix because they live at repo root and are mutated over time.
naming_conventions.week01_prefix_note: All notebook/file prefixes use weekNN_ (two-digit, no hyphen): week01_, week02_, week03_, week04_. Consistent across all weeks. Does NOT mirror the YAML filename convention of week-01.yaml (hyphenated). This is intentional: YAML filenames are course-author artifacts; weekNN_ prefixes are student deliverable names.

model_names.name: claude-3-5-sonnet
model_names.issue: Missing version date suffix. Anthropic's versioned model ID is 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'. The bare 'claude-3-5-sonnet' is an alias that resolves to the latest, which may change. For reproducibility in a research course, pin the date suffix or document explicitly that the alias is intentional.
model_names.proposed_fix: Either use 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022' throughout, or add a course-wide note: 'Model aliases (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet) are used for readability; pin to dated versions (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) in production code.'

model_names.name: Claude claude-3-5-sonnet
model_names.issue: Redundant brand name + model ID concatenation: 'Claude claude-3-5-sonnet'. Should be 'claude-3-5-sonnet' (model ID only in code context) or 'Claude (claude-3-5-sonnet)' (brand + model ID in prose).

model_names.name: gpt-4o-mini
model_names.issue: No pinned version suffix. OpenAI uses date-stamped aliases (e.g., 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18'). Lower priority than claude-3-5-sonnet since OpenAI's versioning is less commonly cited in course materials.
model_names.proposed_fix: Add a note in Week 1 that students should pin model versions in their code and document the version used.

python_packages.name: mp-api
python_packages.note: mp-api IS the correct PyPI package name for the Materials Project REST API Python client (previously accessed via pymatgen). No issue.

python_packages.name: faiss-cpu
python_packages.note: faiss-cpu is the correct PyPI package for CPU-only FAISS. GPU variant is faiss-gpu. No issue for a course environment.

python_packages.name: python-json-logger
python_packages.note: Correct PyPI package name. Note: the import name is 'pythonjsonlogger', not 'python_json_logger'.

python_packages.name: langchain
python_packages.note: Noted as optional in W3. langchain underwent a major API redesign (v0.1 -> v0.2 -> v0.3 with breaking changes). If used, students should pin a specific version.

python_packages.name: llama-index
python_packages.note: Noted as optional in W3. The package was renamed from 'llama-index' to 'llama_index' on PyPI (with hyphen vs underscore instability). Recommend using 'llama-index-core' instead.

issues.description: Peer review filename schemas are inconsistent between W10 and W12. W10 uses <your_lastname>/<partner_lastname>; W12 uses <reviewer>/<author>. Students submitting both assignments face contradictory naming conventions for semantically equivalent roles.
issues.proposed_fix: Standardize to <reviewer_lastname>_reviews_<author_lastname> across all peer review deliverables

issues.description: https://www.aps.org/policy/statements/ai-generated-text.cfm uses .cfm extension (legacy ColdFusion) and APS has restructured their site. Likely to 404 or redirect.
issues.proposed_fix: Replace with https://www.aps.org/policy/statements/ai-generated-text or verify current URL

issues.description: github.com/hackergrrl/art-of-readme is a personal GitHub repo that can be deleted or archived without notice. Course materials should not depend on a single uncontrolled repo.
issues.proposed_fix: Link to a specific commit SHA or to the GitHub README for the archived/popular fork

issues.description: claude-3-5-sonnet appears 8 times without the version date suffix (20241022). In a reproducibility-focused course, using pinned model versions is a core principle that should be modeled in the course materials themselves.
issues.proposed_fix: Use claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 throughout, or add a syllabus note explaining the intentional use of aliases

issues.description: 14 out of 26 URLs are missing the https:// scheme (bare hostnames or paths). These may not render as clickable links in YAML-rendered views and can be ambiguous.
issues.proposed_fix: Prepend https:// to all URLs in tools_and_resources and materials_needed fields

issues.description: W10 tools_and_resources lists 'aps.org' and 'nature.com' as bare root domains without specific policy page paths. Students cannot find the referenced policies from these.
simbad.u-strasbg.fr is the old SIMBAD hostname. CDS officially migrated to simbad.cds.unistra.fr. The old URL still redirects but is deprecated in astroquery docs.
W5 step 3 uses 'Claude claude-3-5-sonnet' (brand name + model ID concatenated without separator) in an example sentence. Minor but inconsistent with all other model name references.
llama-index is listed as optional in W3 but the package has been split; the correct top-level install is now 'llama-index-core' on PyPI.
issues.proposed_fix: Change 'llama-index' to 'llama-index-core' or add a version pin
